components.title: Run Domain public boundary
components.rationale: src/index.ts exports event folding, transition policy, projectable-event mapping and run-domain errors.

components.title: Run event folding
components.rationale: Applies canonical run events to derived workflow snapshots while enforcing lifecycle invariants.

components.title: Run transition policy
components.rationale: Defines legal terminal and lifecycle transition rules independent from provider behavior.

components.title: Projectable event mapping
components.rationale: Normalizes persisted event envelopes into projectable run-domain events for downstream read models.

components.title: Run-domain invariant errors
components.rationale: Typed errors for invalid lifecycle/event transitions.
